platform.name: Complex Multi-Entity
platform.tagline: Harmonizing complexity across entities and systems
platform.description: Organizations managing significant structural complexity — multiple legal entities, diverse ERP landscapes, or active M&A integration. Finance is constantly battling data fragmentation, reconciliation bottlenecks, and consolidation deadlines.
platform.corePain: Our close takes too long and data doesn't reconcile.

growth.name: High-Growth / Venture
growth.tagline: Prioritizing speed and capital allocation over rigid control
growth.description: Fast-scaling organizations where the finance function is racing to keep pace with the business. Investor expectations drive a relentless reporting cadence. Cash runway visibility is existential.
growth.corePain: Investors want answers faster than we can produce them.

margin.name: Margin-Focused Operator
margin.tagline: Maximizing value through unit economics and efficiency
margin.description: Businesses where margin discipline is the primary value lever — whether scaling steadily, holding position, or fighting decline. The CFO is a margin guardian, obsessing over cost allocation accuracy and working capital optimization.
margin.corePain: We don't know our true cost-to-serve.

governance.name: Governance-First
governance.tagline: Auditability and compliance as a competitive foundation
governance.description: Organizations where regulatory requirements, audit scrutiny, or public market obligations make control and documentation non-negotiable. Every process needs a paper trail; every model needs version control.
governance.corePain: We can't afford audit findings or control gaps.

stewardship.name: Long-Term Steward
stewardship.tagline: Sustainable value and resilience across generations
stewardship.description: Family-owned or closely-held private businesses with a multi-generational perspective. Speed matters less than sustainability. The CFO serves as guardian of long-term value, balancing family dynamics with business discipline.
stewardship.corePain: We need to balance family priorities with business discipline.

resilience.name: Liquidity & Resilience
resilience.tagline: Navigating transition with radical transparency and control
resilience.description: Organizations facing financial pressure — whether from market headwinds, operational challenges, or capital structure strain. Cash is oxygen. The finance function shifts from business partnering to survival mode.
resilience.corePain: Will we make payroll? Are we covenant compliant?
